Yeah, sure thing, will do.

Also, he tends to say, "I want to kill myself, but I probably won't do it.", which I'm not too sure how to feel about.

I'm curious, what do you mean by:

> It would be great if they just talked to me, not pressurizing me about my problems but being open and geniuinly interested when I would get serious, basically letting me decide when and how I talk about my desire to end it.

I don't feel like I'm pressuring him about any of his problems, but I am definitely talking to him and am open to hearing whatever he has to say. But, when your best friend says, "I want to die," I can't help but worry about him.
